5470.String: On the happiest day of her life, Haru's world is suddenly torn asunder when the Vacuuum devours her family. In shock, she swears revenge and in so doing unleashes her Soul Energy. Haru wields her sword with a fiery blend of guilt and atonement.

5471.String: Fun is Erwin's greatest motivator – and that goes for his Soul Energy as well. Eyes wide open, he was the only one to walk into the Vacuuum voluntarily. Even the apocalypse cannot wipe that broad grin off his cheerful face.

5472.String: Lily derives her Soul Energy from her smouldering madness. A terrifying encounter with a beast from the Vacuuum drove her over the edge. She tends to act the delicate, well-bred society girl, but behind the mask...

5473.String: Jin is extremely noble and selfless, and his unerring passion feeds his Soul Energy. With complete disregard for his own well-being, he fights injustice wherever he sees it, for the good of humanity. Is that even possible in the ruins of this world...?

5474.String: Sensitive Stella grew up around abusive and hostile people. Her Soul Energy manifests this sorrow. You wouldn't know it to look at those rosy little cheeks, but her Howling Guitar speaks volumes.

5475.String: Deep down inside Iris boils a rage at a world gone awry which unleashes her Soul Energy. She perceives even herself with the same wrath and frustration, vowing to improve herself. But all she hears is a scornful echo which fills her with a livid emptiness.

5800.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font>You can purchase standard Armor from <font color='#00ff9c'>Zyte</font> in districts.

5801.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> You can buy standard consumables from <font color='#00ff9c'>Yomi</font> in every district.

5802.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> In shops, you can <font color='#00D8FF'>[Repair]</font> the durability of your weapons or <font color='#00D8FF'>[Dismantle]</font> your Items.

5803.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> The more frequently you visit functional NPCs, the quicker your <font color='#00D8FF'>[Client Level]</font> will increase. When your Client Lv. increases with an NPC, their services improve.

5804.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> At <font color='#00ff9c'>Trisha's</font> you can <font color='#00D8FF'>[Upgrade]</font> or <font color='#00D8FF'>[Refine]</font> weapons and equipment.

5805.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> If you want to get more out of your Items, you can <font color='#00D8FF'>upgrade</font> them or <font color='#00D8FF'>dismantle</font> them to obtain upgrade or crafting materials.

5806.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> At <font color='#B2EBF4'>[Janice]</font> you can <font color='#00D8FF'>[Craft]</font> weapons, Armor and costume Items.

5807.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> <font color='#00ff9c'>H.E.M.S</font> Use the H.E.M.S facility to send messages to other Players.

5808.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> <font color='#00ff9c'>Oden</font> is the one to entrust your <font color='#00D8FF'>Items</font> to for storage in every district.

5809.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> Use the <font color='#00ff9c'>Mini map</font> to check your own position, that of an <font color='#00D8FF'>NPC</font> and see where <font color='#00D8FF'>Mazes</font> are.

5810.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> For details on Progress, press the hotkey <font color='#00ff9c'>L</font> and see <font color='#00D8FF'>[Achievements] [Sharing Rate]</font>.

5811.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> Depending on your progress, you will find your rewards in <font color='#00D8FF'>Progress</font> <font color='#00ff9c'>[L]</font>.

5813.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> There are some passive <font color='#00D8FF'>Akashic Record</font> that will trigger automatically in combat if you have added them to your slots.

5814.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> New quests can be recognized by an <font color='#fff94a'><font size="30">!</font></font> mark and Completed quests with an <font color='#fff94a'><font size="30">?</font></font> mark.

5815.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> You can see the quests you accepted in <font color='#00D8FF'>Quest Info</font> at the right or by pressing the hotkey <font color='#00ff9c'>[J]</font> to view Quest Info.

5816.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> To bind hotkeys, press <font color='#00ff9c'>ESC</font>. You can change the settings any time in <font color='#00D8FF'>[Settings]</font>.

5817.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> The community has lots of features for <font color='#00D8FF'>[Friend]</font> for you to use.

5818.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30"> TIP。</font> To use an <font color='#00D8FF'>[Skill] [Akashic Record]</font>, open the Akashic menu with the <font color='#00ff9c'>[K] [;]</font> hotkey or via the UI, and add it to your Akashic Record.

5819.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> Rely on your <font color='#00D8FF'>Skill tree</font> for powerful effects in combat.

5820.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> Invest in <font color='#00D8FF'>passive Skills</font> to enhance your active Skills.

5821.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> You can check your own Progress in the <font color='#00D8FF'>Info window</font> at the bottom left.

5822.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font><font color='#00D8FF'>Titles</font> can be set to how you like to have them displayed or applied.

5823.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> You get rewards for <font color='#00D8FF'>Maze Progress</font> and <font color='#00D8FF'>District Progress</font>.

5824.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> Progress in Mazes of a particular zone effect the superordinate <font color='#00D8FF'>Maze progress</font>.

5825.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> When entering a Maze, use <font color='#00D8FF'>[Auto Team Search]</font> to assemble your Team automatically.

5826.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> You can change your Character Info in the <font color='#00D8FF'>profile</font>.

5827.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> Press <font color='#00ff9c'>[ALT]</font> to switch to mouse mode.

5828.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> Once you reach level 55, the </font><font color='#00ff9c'>[Rank]</font> matters.

5829.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> If a channel is too full, use the <font color='#00D8FF'>switch channel</font> feature in the upper part of the mini map.

5830.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> You obtain B.P (<font color='#00ff9c'>BP</font>) for Bucker in <font color='#00D8FF'>District 6</font> and <font color='#00D8FF'>Steel Graves</font>.

5831.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> You can buy special PvP Items in the <font color='#00ff9c'>BP shop</font> in <font color='#00D8FF'>Maze 6</font>.

5832.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> Open <font color='#00D8FF'>Quest Info</font> to see <font color='#00ff9c'>[Daily Mission]</font>.

5833.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> Doing <font color='#00D8FF'>daily quests</font> earns you Gruton Gold, which you can spend in the <font color='#00ff9c'>Gruton Coin</font>.

5834.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> Random </font><font color='#00D8FF'>[Hidden Quests] (HQ)</font> appear within the Mazes.

5835.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> When in Mazes, call upon </font> <font color='#00D8FF'>[Supporter]</font> you acquire as the game progresses. Occasionally, you will receive unexpected aid.

5836.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> Register an </font><font color='#00D8FF'>Orb</font> with <font color='#00ff9c'>Eo</font> so friends can use the Orb for their allies.

5837.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> If it gets too lonely or difficult all by your self, use </font><font color='#00D8FF'>Team Search ‘N'</font> or </font><font color='#00D8FF'>Community [O]</font> to find Players to join you.

5838.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font></font> Found a <font color='#00D8FF'>League</font> or join an existing </font><font color='#00D8FF'>League</font> to make new friends.

5839.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> From Lv.10 you can have a place to call <font color='#00D8FF'>[My Room]</font>.

5840.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> Sometimes a remnant of the old world will appear in the Mazes, known as a <font color='#00D8FF'>Memorial</font>.

5841.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> Click on the golden icon at the top right to access <font color='#00D8FF'>[Help]</font>, which has details on a lot of topics.

5842.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> Entering a Maze consumes <font color='#00D8FF'>[FP]</font>.

5843.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> You can upgrade your <font color='#00D8FF'>Skills</font> and <font color='#00D8FF'>Skill</font> to suit your playing style. New effects can erase and new functions can be added.

5844.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> For favorable combat, it is essential to watch out for <font color='#00D8FF'>[Traumas]</font>.

5845.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> Occasionally you will encounter enemies who have <font color='#00D8FF'>[Super Armor]</font>. If you destroy their Super Armor, the enemy will falter.

5846.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> You can attack with a single mouse click when <font color='#00D8FF'>[Dash]</font> and <font color='#00D8FF'>[Jump]</font>.

5847.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> If you attack an enemy while they are in the air, you can deal additional damage.

5848.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> If you complete certain quests in the Mazes, you will receive <font color='#00D8FF'>Soul Vapor</font> and can use the <font color='#00ff9c'>[Break Skill]</font>.

5849.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> <font color='#00D8FF'>Grutons</font> appear in the Mazes at random.

5850.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> Collect different <font color='#00D8FF'>Items</font> as you progress through the game to grow stronger.

5851.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> If you have Items with sockets you can attach an <font color='#00D8FF'>Familiar</font> to them.

5852.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> If you have costume Items with sockets, you can attach <font color='#00D8FF'>brooches</font> to add Skills to them.

5853.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> When you defeat enemies, they drop <font color='#00D8FF'>Ether</font>. Ether is required for <font color='#00ff9c'>upgrading</font>.

5854.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> To craft an Item, you need its <font color='#00D8FF'>Material Item</font>.

5855.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> When a weapon's <font color='#00D8FF'>durability</font> drops, the Item's effect is reduced.

5856.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> If you want to visit other districts, you first need to cross the bandit zone known as <font color='#00D8FF'>District 6</font>.

5857.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> In District 6 you can use the<font color='#00D8FF'>Starry Forest League's chopper</font> to cross safely.

5858.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> Sometimes you will find upgrade or crafting materials in <font color='#00D8FF'>Vacuum Cubes</font> in District 6.

5859.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> From level 55 onwards you can enter the <font color='#00D8FF'>Casual Raid</font>, known as the [Alternate Vacuum].

5860.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> When you reach Candus City you can enter the combat training zone <font color='#00D8FF'>Steel Graves</font>.

5861.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> You can enter the combat training zone <font color='#00D8FF'>Steel Graves</font> any time you like once you have unlocked it in Candus City.

5862.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> The notorious <font color='#00D8FF'>Very Hard</font> modes yield very special rewards.

5863.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30"> TIP。</font>You can purchase standard Armor from <font color='#00ff9c'>Zyte</font> in districts.

5864.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> You can buy standard consumables from <font color='#00ff9c'>Yomi</font> in every district.

5865.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> In shops, you can <font color='#00D8FF'>[Repair]</font> the durability of your weapons or <font color='#00D8FF'>[Dismantle]</font> your Items.

5866.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> The more frequently you visit functional NPCs, the quicker your <font color='#00D8FF'>[Client Lv.]</font> will increase. When your Client Lv. increases with an NPC, their services improve.

5867.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> At <font color='#00ff9c'>[Trisha]</font> you can <font color='#00D8FF'>upgrade</font> or <font color='#00D8FF'>[Upgrade] [Exchange]</font> weapons and equipment.

5868.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> If you want to get more out of your Items, you can <font color='#00D8FF'>upgrade</font> them or <font color='#00D8FF'>Dismantle</font> them to obtain upgrade or crafting materials.

5869.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> At <font color='#B2EBF4'>[Janice]</font> you can <font color='#00D8FF'>[Craft]</font> weapons, Armor and costume Items.

5870.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> <font color='#00ff9c'>H.E.M.S</font> Use the H.E.M.S facility to send messages to other Players.

5871.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> <font color='#00ff9c'>Oden</font> is the one to entrust your <font color='#00D8FF'>Items</font> to for storage in every district.

5872.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> Use the <font color='#00ff9c'>Mini map</font> to check your own position, that of an <font color='#00D8FF'>NPC</font> and see where <font color='#00D8FF'>Mazes</font> are.

5873.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> For details on Progress, press the hotkey <font color='#00ff9c'>L</font> and see <font color='#00D8FF'>[Achievement] and [Progression]</font>.

5874.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> Depending on your progress, you will find your rewards in <font color='#00D8FF'>Progress [L]</font>.

5876.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> There are some passive <font color='#00D8FF'>Akashic Record</font> that will trigger automatically in combat if you have added them to your slots.

5877.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> When a new quest is Available, you will know by this symbol: <font color='#fff94a'><font size="30">!</font></font> Quests you can complete are indicated by the symbol <font color='#fff94a'><font size="30">?</font></font>.

5878.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> You can see the quests you accepted in <font color='#00D8FF'>Quest Info</font> at the right or by pressing the hotkey <font color='#00ff9c'>J</font> to view Quest Info.

5879.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> To bind hotkeys, press <font color='#00ff9c'>ESC</font>. You can change the settings any time in <font color='#00D8FF'>Options</font>.

5880.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> The community has lots of features for <font color='#00D8FF'>[friends]</font> for you to use.

5881.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> To use an <font color='#00D8FF'>[Skill] [Akashic Record]</font>, open the Akashic menu with the <font color='#00ff9c'>[K] [;]</font> hotkey, and add it to your Akashic Record.

5882.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> Rely on your <font color='#00D8FF'>Skill tree</font> for powerful effects in combat.

5883.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> Invest in <font color='#00D8FF'>passive Skills</font> to enhance your active Skills.

5884.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> You can check your own Progress in the <font color='#00D8FF'>Info window</font> at the bottom left.

5885.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font><font color='#00D8FF'>Titles</font> can be set to how you like to have them displayed or applied.

5886.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> You get rewards for <font color='#00D8FF'>Maze progress</font> and <font color='#00D8FF'>Maze progress</font>.

5887.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> Progress in Mazes of a particular zone effect the superordinate <font color='#00D8FF'>Maze progress</font>.

5888.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> When entering a Maze, use <font color='#00D8FF'>[Auto Team Search]</font> to assemble your Team automatically.

5889.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> You can change your Character Info in the <font color='#00D8FF'>profile</font>.

5890.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> Press <font color='#00ff9c'>[ALT]</font> to switch to mouse mode.

5891.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> Once you reach level 55, the </font><font color='#00ff9c'>[rank]</font> matters.

5892.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> If a channel is too full, use the <font color='#00D8FF'>switch channel</font> feature in the upper part of the mini map.

5893.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> You obtain battle points (<font color='#00ff9c'>BP</font>) for Bucker in <font color='#00D8FF'>District 6</font> and <font color='#00D8FF'>Steel Graves</font>.

5894.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> You can buy special PvP Items in the <font color='#00ff9c'>BP shop</font> in <font color='#00D8FF'>Maze 6</font>.

5895.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> Open <font color='#00D8FF'>Quest Info</font> to see <font color='#00ff9c'>[Daily Mission]</font>.

5896.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> Doing <font color='#00D8FF'>daily quests</font> earns you Gruton Gold, which you can spend in the <font color='#00ff9c'>[Token]</font>.

5897.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> Random </font><font color='#00D8FF'>[Hidden Mission]</font> appear within the Mazes.

5898.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> When in Mazes, call upon </font> <font color='#00D8FF'>[Supporter]</font> you acquire as the game progresses. Occasionally, you will receive unexpected aid.

5899.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> Register an </font><font color='#00D8FF'>Orb</font> with <font color='#00ff9c'>Eo</font> so friends can use the Orb for their allies.

5900.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> If you use the bathtub/Outputer when wearing underwear costume Items...!

5901.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> If you want to change your Character's appearance, you can get <font color='#00D8FF'>[Appearance Item]</font> from the cash shop.

5902.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> <font color='#00D8FF'>[HP]</font> Output your Character's health points. When they reach 0, you die. Always keep an eye on your HP.

5903.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> <font color='#00D8FF'>[SG]</font> stands for Soul Energy, the source of your power. It is consumed when using Skills. The type of SG Recovery will vary depending the Character.

5904.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> You cannot use the Nova Skill <font color='#00D8FF'>[Frenzy][Awakening]</font> in District 6.

5905.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> You cannot use <font color='#00D8FF'>[DRAW]</font> in District 6.

5906.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> It is not possible to <font color='#00D8FF'>equip brooches and socketables</font> in Mazes. Unequip your Armor to socket Items in it.

5907.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> If you don't redeem any points, you won't receive any reward.

5908.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> When another Player dies, you can steal their dimension point.

5909.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font> If you die on a operation, you will respawn automatically.

5910.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font>An Angelic Gruton only appears 1x per map. This just makes their Items more valuable.

5911.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font>A Gruton army attacks to protect ally Grutons in an Invincible state.

5912.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font>Grutons disappear after an allotted amount of time; disappearing Grutons do not drop Items.

5913.String:
Alone this Christmas? No way! 
Noah and Naomin are particularly close to you in December.

5914.String:
There's a joyous supply of Christmas chests Available for a limited time. 
Have fun opening them!

5915.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font>Attacking Void caterpillars consumes the debuffs <font color='#FF0033'>[Tenotomy]</font> and <font color='#FF0033'>[Unsettled]</font> from a Character.

5916.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font>The debuff<font color='#FF0033'>[Falling Soul]</font> will soon be changed to <font color='#FF0033'>[Fallen Soul]</font>. The change only affects one person.

5917.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">Info </font>If nobody is near Yorhaka during battle then <font color='#FF0033'>he blazes with rage</font>. His attacks then become especially dangerous.

5918.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">Info </font>When Yorhaka recovers HP, he activates his <font color='#FF0033'>Super Armor</font>. Destroy the <font color='#FF0033'>Super Armor</font> to halt the Recovery.

5919.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font>Once you have defeated Near SoulWorkers Raban and Enoch, Noah and Sion will follow.

5920.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font>Be careful: Every Near SoulWorker has extremely aggressive Skills as a Awakener.

5921.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font>A special reward chest will appear in the centre once you have defeated all of the Near SoulWorkers.

5922.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font>Don't forget your progress reward for Skyclock Palace!

5923.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font>Near SoulWorker appears sequently when defeating Raban, Enoch, and Noah and Sion.

5924.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font>Near SoulWorker, also the Awakeners, they have powerful Skill, so please be careful.

5925.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font>Special reward box appears from center, if you defeat all Near SoulWorkers.

5926.String: <font color='#FFFFFF'><font size="30">TIP。</font>Don't forget Sky Clock Palace's Progression Reward!

> The Monthly Login Reward is reset on the 1st of each month.

8311.String: Login Check Reward has been given.

8313.String: Daily Login Reward has been given.

8315.String: cannot accept the reward because there's no room in the Inventory.

8348.String: You receive a reward for coming back every day.

9996.String: [The Primal] is only permitted for use as a raid Maze in the most difficult mode for Forces, i.e. 8-Player Teams permitted. Stop the world's downfall and be victorious in Primal Park!

10031.String:
A boot camp where hopefuls are tested before joining the Starry Forest League.
They run easy to tough combat simulations.

10032.String: A building site in Rocco Town. Construction has halted. The NED Company was attempting to extract the Soul Energy hidden underground beneath this construction site.

10033.String:
The abandoned 7th street in Rocco Town.
Defend it against the assault by Mad Edgar's Mannequins and stop the self-destructing Giant Mannequin. The city must be saved!

10034.String: The crazy Vessi joker known as "Pierrot Edgar" has created his own circus troupe at the national hospital and now threatens the inhabitants.

10041.String: A top secret laboratory where the NED Company was carrying out clandestine reSearch. Currently the facility is off-limits due to a mysterious accident.

10042.String:
A motorway near Candus City that the Vessi Rapid Flame Forces have captured.
Currently the Starry Forest League is planning a joint operation with the NED Company to retake the zone.

10043.String:
The NED Company's western branch, located at Candus City centre. This zone is currently occupied by the Rapid Flame forces.
The Energy is lead by the Green Wind Witch, Witch of the Rending Winds.

10044.String: A gigantic transport aircraft that NED Company has provided for the retreat from Candus City. The aircraft is being prepared for take-off in the secret subterranean hangar beneath Candus City.

10051.String: A small suburb in the outskirts of Grace City. The Rapid Flame cash Inventory's new weapon has reduced this little suburb to smoking rubble. The Starry Forest League has dispatched a scout squad to discover the nature of this new weapon.

10052.String: The area along the front line. This is where open war rages between the Starry Forest League and the Rapid Flame cash Inventory. Forced onto the defensive, the SFL intends to establish a base for the rebuilding project by recapturing the area.

10053.String: A subterranean sewage tunnel that extends across Grace City. The Starry Forest League is planning a surprise attack on the Rapid Flame through this area and preparing the operation.

10054.String: A secret military camp of the NED Company. The Starry Forest League discovered the secret agreement between the NED Company and the Rapid Flame, and is now preparing an operation to neutralise this area.

10061.String: The central control system of Ruin Fortress, monitored by the high-powered AI Lucy. The Starry Forest League is attempting to retake this area to grant respite to the Near SoulWorker Search op.

10062.String: The location of the Buster Cores, the main power source of Ruin Fortress. First of all, the deactivated Buster Cores need to be reactivated to restore power inside Ruin Fortress.

10063.String: A secret laboratory inside of Ruin Fortress. Digger, the massive bore, is trying to execute something hidden in the bedrock. The Starry Forest League launches the operation to stop Digger.

10064.String: A tracking operation is launched to catch Abel and Sion, who have fled to the Ark Ship: a gargantuan ship currently being built in secret in the outskirts of Ruin Fortress.

10065.String: Some portal that appeared on the corner of Grasscover Camp, that led a human to some subway. There is a rumor that there are unwanted voices…

10066.String: Investigation of Vacuum finally began. SFL has started an investigation after discovering the land which has been occupied by Rapid Flame.

10067.String: A chilly park that no one comes in and out. Animals and plants that have been eroded by Soul Junks are finally roRanng for prey.

10068.String: A factory that shines alone in the dark where even moonlights cannot go through. There is a crying scream coming from inside.

10081.String:
The Mist of Madness that Mad Edgar had sprayed still hung over Rocco Town, lurking.
Defend R Square against the major assault by Mad Edgar's Mannequins.

10089.String:
Mad Edgar is preparing the final parade, which is to be the culmination of the attack on Rocco Town. 
But this is where the brutal festival will end.

10090.String: As the self-destruct button is activated, the last escape route from the N-102 laboratory opens. Defeat the terrifying Beholder blocking the way and return safely.

10091.String:
The evil greed of the NED Company led to forbidden Experiments on live human subjects.
Stop the SoulWorker production project and grant peace to the victims.

10092.String:
Another way to reach the Acheron, where the strongest robots have slept, waiting to be completed.
Break through the robots who have Awaken from their long sleep, and bring the operation to a successful close.

10097.String:
The remaining Soul Junk horde and Mad Edgar's Mannequin army are up to their evil tricks in Rocco Town again.
Smothered in thick fog and smoke, Rocco Town must be defended to the last.

10105.String:
Abnormal Void, everywhere. There came from nowhere and filled all of Cloudream.
One even in a deserted sector of the city. This void was different to the others.
Whilst the Vessi continued to stream out of the gaping void in the sky down onto the streets, other beings started to gather in each sector, in a form very similar to that of SoulWorkers.
The Starry Forest League lost the ability to tell friend from foe and, as a solution, put a machine to work: it was supposed to banish these strange

13005.String: The verification failed due to system maintenance.

15000.String:
A testing ground for the combat Skills of Starry Forest League soldiers. 
Robots modified for testing await the SFL combatants.

15001.String: Miriam rushed to the drill site, where work had been halted to rescue a child. But the sudden Soul Junk assault cut her off.

15002.String: Soul Junk, Dread roams the construction site. He is the culprit who destroyed Warren's hospital and terrorized Rocco Town with an epidemic alert. Kill him before he spreads the plague.

15003.String:
Heeding Miriam's request, you have just reached the drill site.
Survivors stranded here must be found and brought to safety.

15004.String: Ryu went to the place where awakeners was sighted by himself. Who knows what's going to happen, you've got to help him quickly.

15005.String:
The Clown's invitation points to the deserted road of the main square.
What gifts await you there?

15006.String:
Countless mannequins crowd the roads around the main square.
A road that was once teeming with people and life
has turned into a road of soulless dolls.

15007.String: To stop Big Puppet's advance, a helicopter will be needed that happens to belong to the NED Company. The mannequins have got to be stopped before they destroy the helicopter.

15008.String:
Operation [The Shield].
A dangerous operation in which Big Puppet is lured into the defence wall and its self destruct triggered. The operation must not fail.

15009.String:
The mannequin forces has resurfaced.
The scout squad sent to investigate them hasn't returned, either. You sense a sinister aura.

15010.String:
Humans who have become mannequins, a tower that emits a sinister aura, and mannequins labouring tirelessly...
What are the mannequins building the tower for?

15011.String:
It was the tower that turned the people into mannequins.
Benjamin orders the tower's destruction, before it can wreak even more havoc.

15012.String:
The talking mannequin, codename: Jack The King
The only way to escape this situation is to defeat Jack The King.

15013.String:
Finally, the Blue Flame Clown has been tracked down.
He is in an abandoned hospital near Rocco Town. Find the vanguard and pursue the Blue Flame Clown.

15014.String:
According to your Info you need a special badge to reach the Blue Flame Clown. 
You can find the badge on the mannequin servants inside the hospital.

15015.String: You reached the ward where the Blue Clown is based. The badge got you through the magnetic field, and you finally reached the Clown.

15016.String:
The Blue Flame Clown, Mad Edgar, fled and challenged you to a Outputdown in the circus tent on the hospital roof. 
The final fight begins. He must be stopped, whatever the cost.

15017.String: You have scarcely arrived in the new town and you aren't given a moment's rest. The next operation is already underway: Clear out the Soul Junks on the coastal road to secure the supply route to Candus City.

15018.String:
The reports from NED mercenaries of another powerful Soul Junk on the coastal road have been confirmed. 
They say he is in a constant rage...

15019.String: Recently, the coastal roads have experienced inexplicable earthquakes. There is a risk that this might cause flyovers and buildings to collapse. We must find out what is causing the earthquakes and solve the problem.

15020.String: Yet another pack of Soul Junks has appeared. To defend Candus City, Lieutenant Colonel Aaron gives orders to eliminate the Soul Junks and detonate the last remaining supply route: the coastal tunnel.

15021.String:
Given permission by the NED Company, you have reached the subterranean sewage tunnels.
You nearly choke on the stench.
It feels like something really is alive here.

15022.String: Several parts of the city now stink like the sewers. It is evident that the source of the abominable stench must lie in the sewer system.

15023.String: The NED Company has assembled a large squad of mercenaries and reSearchers and sent them into the sewers. Brooke, who grew suspicious of their activities, ordered them surveilled.

15024.String: The arrival of the Junk Knight shocks the entire Starry Forest League. To hold the NED Company accountable, Brooke orders a sample procured from the Junk Knight.

15025.String:
You have learned that a NED Company dropship has crashed in a nearby residence. 
We must learn what was on board.

15026.String:
The entire residence has turned into a Soul Junk's lair.
There is a highly contagious Soul Junk here. It should be killed before it gets outside.

15027.String: Ralph says it is believed that Catherine is somewhere deep inside the residence. Go further into the residence find Catherine.

15028.String:
Supposedly, the Soul Junk Arachness who abducted Catherine has hidden deep below the residence. 
We must find Catherine soon.

15029.String: It is said that the only antidote to Catherine's infection from Vacuum Vein is located within the NED Company's laboratory. But the lab has already become a cave teeming with Soul Junks.

15030.String: The second lab was a Soul Junk's lair as well. Who knows what made these places change so drastically, but the priority is to find the antidote for Catherine.

15031.String:
Racked with guilt over losing Catherine, Victor entered the depths of the laboratory alone to find the antidote.
He must be found before a Soul Junk gets him.

15032.String: Henry says that to be effective, the antidote requires secretions from Beholder, and he also gave orders to demolish the laboratory.

15033.String: Right after returning from Rocco Town, a massive army of Soul Junks attacked Candus City. To rescue the people, the control unit for the air raid shelter has got to be opened.

15034.String: An inordinate number of Soul Junks were discovered inside the air raid shelter and on the way to the transport airship. They have to be killed first to protect people from being attacked.

15035.String: Most of the inhabitants had been taken to safety. Only we and Catherine remained. It was at that very moment we discovered a mass of Soul Junks heading toward the transporter we were supposed to board.

15036.String:
After leaving Candus City behind, our flight began in earnest. 
But the pack of Soul Junks attacked the airship with tenacity. Everyone was extremely concerned.

15037.String: Although there was barely enough time to pursue Henry as it was, orders came down to bring back Vessi. The orders must be followed, for now.

15038.String: The Rapid Flame Vessi which lusts for power. The Rapid Flame's assault squad is planning to invade Grace City via the motorway and awaits its opportunity.

15039.String: A vehicle that Henry supposedly used has been found. Plenty of questions remain, but first we have got to save him before he is attacked by the Vessi.

15040.String: No trace of Henry, target of the revenge, but [Scar], leader of the Rapid Flame cash Inventory, has Outputn himself on the motorway. To learn of Henry's location, Sukkarak must be stopped.

15041.String: An urgent message has arrived stating that the Rapid Flame raid squad took the NED Company office compSedurin after Henry penetrated the NED HQ. We have got to rescue him, unfortunately.

15042.String: Since the Rapid Flame captured the building, the power supply inside the NED Company has been erratic.

15043.String: To restore power to the NED Company, it has to be activated by hand from inside the building. Evidently, the Rapid Flame has the key.

15044.String: To obtain evidence of Henry's deeds in Candus City, all data from the security box inside the NED Company needs to be copied.

15045.String: This operation is about stopping the Rapid Flame's attack squad before they reach the second motorway. To activate Wolf Cry, secure the shooting position for the Mountain Troll.

15046.String: Operation [Wolf Cry]'s target is to launch the high frequency rocket F-ARIA to neutralise Queen Garura, the attack squad's mainstay.

15047.String: The Mountain Troll cannot move until F-ARIA is launched. Together with Kane Barrel, a SoulWorker of the Starry Forest League, the Rapid Flame attack squad must be stopped.

15048.String: When his beloved mount Queen Garura is wounded, Falcon, commander of the Rapid Flame attack squad appears. Isn't it glorious when an enemy so rarely seen in person Outputs himself?

15049.String: In a deserted place where silence smothers the roads, the cold rain in Deaf Town only spurs the ominous sense of foreboding.

15050.String: Deaf Town, a little town near Grace City, is home to many people. With the war far off, Deaf Town has retained economic independence.

15051.String: One can only hope this foreboding will be gone with the rain. There is no time! The SoulPath markers have to be set up to discover how Soul Energy flows through Deaf Town.

15052.String: The ominous sense of foreboding became reality, after all. What are they after, doing such terrible things...? Well, we've got to Search for survivors first.

15053.String: And so it is that the alliance stands between Henry and the Rapid Flame cash Inventory. Henry must be stopped and finally brought to justice for his unspeakable deeds.

15054.String: The place believed to be the Rapid Flame headquarters turned out to be a trap set by the NED Company working hand in glove with the Rapid Flame.

15055.String: The NED Company's malignant stratagem placed Grace City in a perilous position from which it could not escape. We cannot let them die like that!

15056.String: The Rapid Flame's kill squad is preventing the relief squad from carrying out the rescue op. If we are to save even one person, the enemies preventing it must be eliminated.

15057.String: There are indications the NED Company hacked the military's Indra satellite. We need to trace the hack to find its source.

15058.String: The trail leads to a place near the mountains, in the outskirts of Grace City. It's time to let them feel a punishing blade.

15059.String: To locate Henry and Rauper, the interference signal that is crippling the military satellite has to be shut off.

15060.String: Indra's scan of the facility interior Outputs two life forms, probably Henry and Rauper. Finally the time has come to avenge them.

15061.String:
A virtual training simulator the Starry Forest League has developed exclusively for SoulWorkers. 
Enemies registered in the database are set up as holograms or robots to simulate a realistic combat situation. The simulator consumes a lot of power and cannot be used very often.

15062.String:
A zone that has been laid to waste by the Vacuum.
Soul Junks appear here constantly. The Starry Forest League has marked the area off limits to civilians.

15063.String:
The sudden appearance of the mysterious distortion unleashed countless mannequins onto Earth.
Nobody knows where they come from or how they managed to invade our world.
All we know is that they are powerful and hostile.

16100.String:
An upside down world.
Stunned people.
Unbelievable stories.
Everything I knew has come crashing down.
What... what's going to become of me?

16200.String:
I awake from a 15-year-long slumber to find all hell has broken loose.
Monsters roam and humans have supernatural powers.
I find myself in the world I always dreamed of.
It's all so unsettling, so different... so thrilling.

16300.String:
A world which has no room for the things we took for granted...
Well...
I never took anything for granted.
I fought hard and bitterly for everything by the sweat of my brow.
That won't change now... not even in this world.

16400.String:
They say a lot has changed in the last 15 years.
They say that survival is all that matters in today's world.
Huh... what can I say?
Survival has always been all that mattered to me.

16500.String:
When I opened my eyes, I was told I had been asleep for 15 years.
Do they think I'm a bear that hibernates?
They keep talking about things I don't understand. Plus, I'm starving, and nobody's giving me anything to eat...
Hm... at least I'm with everyone else instead of all by myself.
I guess that's something.

16600.String:
The world I knew is gone.
Everything seems to strange and unpleasant. I don't want to stay here a minute longer.
But I've got to face it.
This is the world I'm going to be living in.
I've got to persevere and tough it out.

40721.String: Look look! Me Setsuka had really funny dream last night

40722.String: Daddy was there, and Glain, and we all went to R Square to play again! And the big wolfies were soooo happy!

40723.String:
The poor wolfies were so hungry, but I didn't have anything for them!
I need to ask Yomi if she has any treats!

40724.String:
This little mini mannequin lit lots of candles!
I think it was really happy to see me!

40725.String:
The giant puppet even patted me on the head...
When it hugs me I sink into its marshmallow belly!

40726.String:
There were even giant rocks
 rolling around!

40727.String: I wanted to roll with them but I wasn't round enough so I plopped onto my bum!

40728.String: But a mega big clump of rock then helped me up again!

40729.String: And then! Then a ball with giant round eyes stared at me... and I stared right back. I was super brave!

40730.String: And then! Then this little thing wanted to shake hands with way to many hands! Oh oh, but I only had two!

40731.String: But then! Then this guy with no face waved at me, because I waved at him!

40732.String:
Yeah, and then there was another guy who had four arms!
He would have gotten on well with Biriri I bet!

40733.String: Oh! And then, there was an uncle, he looked like our uncle neighbour! I'll say hello to him next time!

40734.String:
Oh and there was a pretty lady, prettier than any dolly. Nearly as pretty as Aunty Miriam!
I'll have to tell her!

40735.String:
Oh! And an uncle, he was really shouty and kept waving his axe about.
‘What was I doing here'... *shivers* help!

40736.String: But I think he was just trying to warn me that it was dangerous.

40737.String: *yawn* I am going back to sleep. I'll tell you how my dream continues next time! Byeeeee!

10026.String: Having seen a horror film, Setsuka has nightmares that night. Meet the scary people of Setsuka's dreams.

40817.String: I fell asleep after watching a scary movie with monsters and wild animals and weird men last night.

40818.String: But then, in the dream, I was standing in a dark alley all alone!

40819.String: And then all these dirty-looking puppies started following me! I ran far far away because it looked like it would hurt if I got bit!

40820.String: I was running furiously until... suddenly... I ended up in a place I'd never seen before.

40821.String: But the monster and weird ghosts were riding a big fish and tried to eat me!

40822.String: And then the woodsman I saw in the movie appeared out of nowhere with an axe in his hand.

40823.String: Black and white armored knights started fighting the woodsman and scary ghosts.

40824.String: And then white and black cloaked priests started swinging around their wands fighting with each other...

40825.String: And then the priest boss wearing big and colorful clothes shouted and everyone became suddenly quiet!

40826.String: But after that, wide-eyed monsters and spikey monsters came running to me and it scared me.

40827.String: But THEN! A really pretty lady appeared waving her wand with sparkly things that got rid of all the monsters!!

40828.String: I think she was a little older than Ryoko!

40829.String: She told me to not come here anymore because it's dangerous. But I think I'll want to visit again because she was so nice~!

103015.String:
Haru Estia. 15 years ago, a sudden Vacuum that appeared took her mother away making her jump in to become a hero the pre-existing world would never know.

Although her heart is filled with nothing but vengeance, she has the dedication to save the world.

103025.String:
Erwin Arclight. Wanting to achieve nothing else, this young man voluntarily jumped into the Vacuum 15 years ago becoming a never-before-seen hero of a devastated world.

Although his emotions are for self gain, his want to save the world continues on.

103035.String:
Lily Bloommerchen. 15 years ago, after losing her brother to a monster that suddenly appeared from the Vacuum, this young woman dives into the devastated world to become a hero.

Although her emotions may be self-destructive, her want to save the world continues on.

103045.String:
Jin Seipatsu. 15 years ago, a giant disaster made this young man dive into the Vacuum making him into a never-before-seen hero.

Althouugh his emotions may stem from his failures, his want to save the world continues on.

103055.String:
Stella Unibell. 15 years ago, this young girl threw herself into the Vacuum after having felt discarded by everyone around her, allowing her to become a hero the devastated world has never seen before.

Although her emotions are full of sorrow, her want to save the world continues.

103065.String:
Iris Yuma. 15 years ago, after having had an enraged fight with her family about her future, she walks into the Vacuum to become a hero this devastated worldr has never seen before.

Although her emotions are driven by blind trust in herself, her want to save the world continues on.

103075.String:
Aruel and Chii. That small and young kitten grew up to be a hero in a devastated world with the young girl that took care of her.

Although she's filled with desire to see her friend once more, her want to save the world continues on.

103085.String:
F.N.EL. This young girl who was sold off as a live experiment is reborn as a hero never seen before in a devastated world.

Although she does not bend to many people, her want to save the world continues on.

103095.String:
Lee Nabi. Looking up at the sky where stars are no longer shining brightly as they used to, a young girl rises as a man-made hero.

Although her devotion is blind, her want to save the world continues on.

103016.String:
Haru Estia came face to face with the dark emotions of vengeance inside of herself. Would it be lost when this battle ended? Or would she have to live a life with vengeance in her heart her entire life? Haru Estia decided to look for a new fueling emotion; something that would keep her sharp during battles.

She is now the SoulWorker of Vitality.

103026.String:
The reason he no longer wished for anything else is probably because he didn't feel the need for human interaction. Even if he was a genius, he couldn't fully understand the promises made, friendship, love or anything like that between humans. Although, Erwin Arclight didn't really care for any of that; until he met the small girl who whispered her heart to him, that is. Losing someone to protect left him empty inside and decided to devote his life to it.

He is now the SoulWorker of Vow.

103036.String:
People who don't know their self worth often are not scared by the idea of death; Lily Bloommerchen being one of them. But if that's the case, what had she been fighting for her entire life? How had she been strengthening herself in the Vacuum? Moreover... why wasn't she satisfied with her killings? Nothing made sense, but she finally figured it out; her goal wasn't to kill but to face a more satisfied final battle...

She is now the SoulWorker of Last Stand.

103046.String:
Vanguards have the lonliest roles; they must push through the bleak. That's what heroes do; they must blaze the path for their followers. This is what he thought, anyway. Followers don't just leave the hero alone but cheer them on and support them from behind; this is what Jin Seipatsu learned the hard way.

He is now the SoulWorker of Unity.

103056.String:
Fear of sorrow along with not wanting to cry have both led and suffocated Stella Unibell. This dark emotion fueled her hatred towards humans and left her with an indefinite pain inside the Vacuum. However, this little girl is not the same any longer; she wishes to trust others and sing along with them, not afraid to face disappointment or to look away from fear.

She is now the SoulWorker of Hope.

103066.String:
Anger is best used when pointed at someone other than yourself; being on the receiving end means you have to man up to it. But that wasn't the case for Iris Yuma. She always blamed the adults whenever something happened to the world. It's not like she was completely wrong, however. But she couldn't continue living this way; she realized she wouldn't be able to know the ways of the world. That's when she found the courage to blame herself and take responsibility.

She is now the SoulWorker of

103076.String:
People don't introduce themselves as humans; neither do cats. Although Chii Aruel has repeatedly stated that she's a cat, she's realized she's neither a human or a cat; just herself. But this was hard for her to admit; it would mean she's a monster pretending to be human. Though she couldn't become a human, she wished to be a cat among the humans. She then came to the conclusion that she'd be a cat PROTECTING humans.

She is now the SoulWorker of Will; she's still also a cat!

103086.String:
Ephnel is more of something similar to a SoulWorker than an actual one, and she hated the label that came along with it; the same went with saying that Near SoulWorkers are basically finished products and something they called destiny. Fury, revenge and the want to live on changed her entirely from her past to her future.

She is now the SoulWorker of Renewal.

103096.String:
What's the difference between a servant and a subordinate? A peasant and a subject? Sages used to say that subjects got to choose who they served. After being forced into submission of Ysabella, Lee Nabi decides to look for her own master. Although she may be lacking in many areas, it's worth saying she's changed since she's taking charge of her own life now.

Lee Nabi is now the SoulWorker of Devotion.

33011.String: The Void still gaped its black mouth in the sky, and the girl still had to fight. There is no telling when peace will come. Peace that can only be obtained through struggle - how contradictory. But even today, her fighting spirit did not break.

33012.String: A promise that can never be kept forever. With the pistol in his hand, the boy recalled the whisper of the tiny girl he could never meet again. The end of the chaos is not in sight, but he now knows where to go. All that remains is to rise again and walk.

33013.String: He does not mock just anyone. If one has worthy character, he acknowledges them. But he does not associate with the vulgar and shallow. Lily knew it herself - that even if her house fell, the nobility flowing in her blood remains.

33014.String: One is weak, but many are strong. The realization Jin grasped pushed him to the next stage. If he joins hands with those who trust and support him, what was impossible alone will no longer be impossible.

33015.String: The most fitting thing for a fourteen-year-old girl is to play, not to be thrown onto a battlefield where life and death are divided. The sea delighted the girl and washed away the sorrow piled in a corner of her heart. Someday the adults will have to express their gratitude.

33016.String: Iris Yuma had gained the courage to admit her own faults. But admitting one's faults is difficult and requires courage every time. As long as you have the courage to rise again, you will not collapse.

33017.String: Usually one rarely looks at oneself, especially when one is a cat. She scooped a cat onto the bed, lay beside it, and quietly watched. It was cute. Was this why Aruel embraced her too?

33018.String: There's no need to weigh this and that. If you move forward and change, even by smashing through, that's enough. Efnel was not afraid of taking a loss. If necessary, she will break through and advance at any time.

33019.String: Firmly planting both feet, gripping the gun with both hands, casting a gaze beyond the sight. But even while falling, even with a pistol if the rifle is lost, there is something that must be done - pulling the trigger.

I’ve actually fought with great a many enemies back in my

How did I live in the past?

I can’t believe you’re making me think of it... You’re not a good person, are you?
Let’s see... I used to study and work a lot before the Vacuum.
I walked into the Vacuum myself and walked out and found myself in Rocco Town.
And the fact I’m saving people remains the same before and after.
And that’s why I’m still in Rocco Town and all.
Plus... I wanted to be a nurse, so I went into

When the world becomes dark and wars are all around, that’s when they say the number of people you love increases. I don’t know where those statistics came from. I just remember reading it somewhere.
It was the same for me. I loved the one who saved us from the Vacuum. It was when SoulWorker Lord disappeared and we were waiting for someone to lead us. That’s when he appeaered and showed us what justice really meant. Although it was merely envy and respect for most people.... But not to me.

103125.String:
There once was a girl. The worst day imaginable couldn’t have avoided this girl who helped people with the warmest of hearts.
A new hope found this girl who was living a life of no light.
Although the world seemed to be filled with deceit, Dhana Opini puts one foot in front of the other holding hope in her heart.

103126.String:
However, even in a life of deceit, Dhana did not resort to tears. In order to hold on to the small ray of light and truth she had left, she desperately clung on and arose from the deceit she knew.
In a world that has turned its back on her, Dhana continues living on with hope in her heart.
As long as that hope is still alight, this SoulWorker will continue on with that trust.

102066.String:
This doctor is usually talking nonsense without any context.
Although, sometimes they’re philosophical about how a person should go down the path they’re on.

He is grotesque and makes grotesque comments, but if you get to know him, he is a compassionate and friendly doctor who can 'cure' any disease if he finds a patient.

Due to an incident in the past, he now he's back to his original "Save people" mindset, and it seems to have calmed his personality.

102067.String:
It was a really sunny day that day.
A patient knowing of his upcoming demise of an unknown disease was enjoying his long-deserved vacation.
On his walk with a lonesome heart, he tripped over something and heard a voice from somewhere...

“A patient... I'll save you.”

The soldier lost all consciousness not even being able to scream with a shock much like a car crash that came along with the voice.

And who knows how much time had passed...

“I- It’s weird... My body...!”
“I feel so alive! This

102068.String:
Did you hear?
With an eerie sound, an unexpected pain overcame him... warming him and dragging him somewhere...
And then he was abandoned in some places into an unfamiliar place with another strange sound.

And when he woke up, his condition returned.

Good? How is it good that my hair's an AFRO in the morning?!

103135.String:
A genius swordsman diligent in work, relations, and morality.
Helping others in the name of justice is his strong suit.

He has been popular since childhood, showed talent as a swordsman, and rose to the position of leader of the Holy Knights at the age of 16.

He was in rivalry with Sol Badguy, but they soon began to acknowledge and trust each other.

103136.String:
Because the justice I believed in was turned down, I have lost my own identity.
Gears were ones to be destroyed at that time.
But once I found out about the truth and the justice I thought to be was overturned, I couldn’t think of anything at all.

That’s when I met Dizzy.
I was lost... but when I found her, I knew what real justice really was.
She’s someone special who stopped me from losing myself completely.

103137.String:
P-Please don’t talk about that.

I.. So... The thing is...
Sol is m-my... Father-in... He’s Dizzy’s father.

I heard Justice is a girl Sol loved in the past turned into a Gear...
And Dizzy is the daughter of the Gear called Justice.

So... So...
Sol is my... Father-in...
AAAAAAAAAACK!!!!!!!!!

-Ky Kiske, wanting to deny the reality laid out in front of him, quickly ends interview-

103145.String:
She looks like a cold woman on the outside, but in reality is a manmade entity called “Valentine” and has half of the soul of someone called Aria.

Her true self isn’t technically born yet, so she sometimes reverts to a child-like disposition when in an unstable environment.

Because the soul of someone in an older time is in her, she sometimes uses out-of-date phrases.

103146.String:
Huh? Why are you so upset?
Ah~Ha! You’re talking about him like that again, aren’t you?
Huhu.... But, you know, Fredrick’s not a bad guy.
Of course, he can seem like that on the outside. But his name is “Sol Badguy”, isn’t it?
He just LOOKS like a terrible dude!
And he makes it seem like he doesn’t want to do ANYTHING!
And he gets annoyed when he’s bored.
Seeing as how he’s so sharp with every single word out of his mouth... 
Anyone can take one look at him and think he’s a bad person,

103147.String:
Hey, uhm...
Are there, like, hip phrases people use here?
Oh, why am I asking? Just listen! 
I was just talking like I normally do yesterday, and apparently I sound old!
I know it’s not grown-up to take this to heart or anything, but... It’s still on my mind, you know?
So can you teach me some?

Oh, and of course! You can’t tell anyone; this is a secret, okay?

104086.String:
Known as Bounty Hunter in the real world, but known as Flame of Corruption.

Blunt and bothered by anything in his way, he is quite poor and expressing himself. Expressing himself in actions instead of words, people just accept him the way he is saying that he "can't be helped."

104087.String:
It’s annoying with a lot of people around.
Bringing extra people along with me?
It’s not in my nature.

Bringing people along...
That means I have more responsibility than I should be taking responsibility for.
I don’t like that extra annoying responsibility.

The people around me?
I mean... They’re already there, so there’s nothing I can do.

104088.String:
This peaceful day is somehow getting away from me.
I don’t have to get caught up in disgustingly tedious things.
And I don’t have anything to do.
Maybe it also means I don’t have to use my brain too much.

I mean, it’s good... this kind of nothingness.

104096.String:
The entity called “Valentine”, born in the place called the “Backyard” looks like a normal human being.

Valentine has no feelings and has no feelings of like or dislike other than the mission at hand.
She thinks of even her own life as a tool used to complete her mission.

But it looks as though she has at least some emotions to Ramlethal.

104097.String:
This... is a hamburger?
Huh, there are hamburgers here too.
We have hamburgers where I come from too.
I've never understood that food could be so warm and yummy.

I didn't know anything outside of things necessary or not.

104098.String:
I’m a manmade creation called Valentine.
I moved only according to my purpose, but now my heart is telling me where I should go.

I don't understand much about emotions such as sadness or happiness, but I think I'm starting to understand.

I'm practicing my smile; there's someone I wish to show it to.

104106.String:
That’s right. I’m the one and only... 
QuadStella TriSilva’s Fourth Star, Lugman!

Let me guess what you want to say right now. 
“Who knew the Star of Information would be a tiny kid like this?”
Right? 

Haha, all idiots think alike! 

I’m warning you; don’t judge me by how I look!
If not, you’ll see what I’m capable of~ 
And you’ll be sorry!!

The Intelligence Unit of Orca is by far the most invincible! 

Everyone in the Unit, including the leader Belletto, bows down to me.

And there’s no way a Unit like that wouldn’t be first in Starry Forest League, right? 

Huh? Orca's Idol? Me? 

Shut up! No one knows what I look like. 
How can I become the idol of something... 

Wait, what the hell is this fan club! 
Belletto this bastard... What the hell do you think you’re doing!

Oh~ Belletto? 

He’s an idiot that doesn’t know anything but fighting. 
And he does cling to me so much I want to punch his face.. 
But he is my favourite minion..? of some kind. 

He does anything I tell him to. 
And he takes care of Orca’s Intelligence Unit because they annoy me too much.

Oh, you think I’m overworking him? It’s alright! 
I’m always giving him the best rewards for his jobs! 

Let’s see... What should I give him this time..
